name: Spaceship 58ce78e3 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-006
description: A period-10 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-006 (touching neighbours), 4 to 9 cells, moving one lattice step every 10 generations (c/10). It runs the same way in the 4,096 rules from B36/S23 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,3,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-028, k3-029 and k3-030. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-029 (seen 43 times). Flagged to check before claiming: runs in HighLife (B36/S23). We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
